name: shadows-that-look-right
description: Get crisp, stable, correctly placed shadows in three.js: enable the shadow map, fit the directional light's shadow camera to the scene bounds, pick a map size, tune bias and normalBias against shadow acne and peter-panning, soften with shadow.radius, catch shadows on an invisible ground with ShadowMaterial, and freeze the shadow map for static scenes. Use when shadows are missing, blocky, pixelated, striped (acne), detached from the object (peter-panning), cut off at an edge, flickering, too dark, or too slow on mobile, or when the user asks how to add shadows or a ground shadow under a model.
